name: app-sessions
title: App Sessions
description: Start and end groups of apps with optional Apple Shortcuts and Raycast command automation
author: yasinkavakli

commands.name: start-session
commands.title: Start Session
commands.description: Open all apps and run the start Shortcut for a session

commands.name: end-session
commands.title: End Session
commands.description: Gracefully quit all apps and run the end Shortcut for a session

commands.name: manage-sessions
commands.title: Manage Sessions
commands.description: Create, edit, and delete app sessions

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
